notes: The request is answerable from the schema. Summer offerings are directly identified by COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM. Instructor counts and longest instructor-name length can be derived through LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED → LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL → LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR. No strict ambiguity span is required. The exact stored value representing “offered in summer” is not shown in the schema, so the predicate value ('Y', etc.) must be confirmed from metadata/data values.
